hero.intro: I build the Ford Credit mobile app, co-lead a 250-member graduate program, and spend my off hours teaching karate, mentoring a robotics team and working the Eagles gameday crew.

site.bioTeaser: Born and raised in Bensalem, Pennsylvania, I'm trying to give back to the community that helped me grow up. By day I'm an iOS developer at Ford Credit; the rest of my time goes to teaching karate, mentoring a robotics team, serving at my church and working Eagles game days.
